messages.author: fe53999a356f62d4
messages.subject: Re: [RRO] Windows Installation of MKL for MRO 3.23
parts:
I had the exact same problem installing MKL on Windows 10 64-bit with pre/co-existing R3.2.3 | Rstudio latest.

Solved it by locating the msi file that was extracted during the install - it was in my temp directory - called "tmpB5D2.tmp.msi" but I think this name varies - and just executed the install process directly using that msi file. No additional parameters. The msi file itself requested for elevation to admin privileges.

It appears to work as confirmed by "
Multithreaded BLAS/LAPACK libraries detected. Using 4 cores for math algorithms."

and appears as RevoMath-3.2.3 under Programs | Uninstall
